r.정치 구도: A federal presidential system in which presidents serve a single six-year term and cannot run again. Morena has governed since 2018; the first woman president was elected in 2024, and the party also dominates Congress. A 2024 judicial reform that made judges elected raised concerns about judicial independence. Drug-cartel violence badly shakes local elections and security.

t.why: It shares a border of more than 3,000 km with the United States, so tariffs, migration and drug enforcement are always negotiated together. Thanks to its trade agreement with the United States and Canada, it has emerged as a production base close to the US market, with more factories choosing Mexico over China, and it has become the United States' largest trading partner. A large Latin American economy, it is a G20 member. As the route Latin American migrants take to the United States, it is at the center of migration issues.
t.rel: Its economy is deeply tied to the United States to the north through a trade agreement, but they clash often over the border wall and deportations. Its southern border with Guatemala and Belize is the route Central American migrants take to the United States, so it handles migration with its neighbors.
t.korea: The two established relations in 1962. Kia, Samsung, LG and others have plants in Mexico aimed at the US market, so changes in US-Mexico tariffs affect Korean companies too. There is a history of Korean immigrants who went to work on henequen plantations in 1905.
t.know: Mexico City stands on the site of the Aztec city built on an island in a lake, so the ground is still slowly sinking.
etext: Bordering the United States and bound to it by the USMCA, it makes cars, electronics, medical devices and appliances for the US market. Many companies moving factories out of China choose Mexico.
It is the world's largest silver producer and also produces crude oil. Remittances from people working in the United States are a big source of foreign currency.
Its reliance on the United States is so great that it is shaken hard by US tariff and immigration policies. The state oil company's debt, organized crime and power shortages are burdens too.
